spiffe_x509_svid_leaf_constraints.key_usage_presence: KeyUsage MUST be present (SVID_KEY_USAGE_MISSING if missing)
spiffe_x509_svid_leaf_constraints.key_usage_criticality: KeyUsage MUST be marked critical (SVID_KEY_USAGE_NOT_CRITICAL if non-critical)
spiffe_x509_svid_leaf_constraints.key_usage_flags: digitalSignature=true MUST be set; keyCertSign=false & crlSign=false MUST NOT be set
spiffe_x509_svid_leaf_constraints.uri_san_count: EXACTLY ONE URI SAN required (MISSING_SPIFFE_ID_IN_SVID if 0; SVID_SPIFFE_ID_AMBIGUOUS if > 1)
spiffe_x509_svid_leaf_constraints.spiffe_uri_format: Scheme MUST be spiffe:// and path MUST be non-root (spiffe://<td>/<path>)
spiffe_x509_svid_leaf_constraints.extended_key_usage: If EKU present, BOTH clientAuth AND serverAuth MUST be set
spiffe_x509_svid_leaf_constraints.trust_domain_confinement: Trust domain extracted from SVID MUST match expected trust domain
spiffe_x509_svid_leaf_constraints.validity_window: now MUST be between not_before and not_after
